My brother is ____ than me. = taller | more tall | tallest | the most tall
This book is ____ than that one. = more interesting | interestinger | most interesting | more interested
Everest is ____ mountain in the world. = the highest | the higher | highest | more high
Today is ____ than yesterday. = hotter | hoter | more hot | hottest
She is ____ student in our class. = the best | the goodest | the better | best
My old phone was ____ than this one. = worse | badder | worst | more bad
This exercise is ____ than the last one. = easier | more easy | easiest | easyer
He runs ____ than his friend. = faster | more fast | fastest | more faster
Winter in London is ____ than in Cairo. = colder | more cold | coldest | the colder
This is ____ film I have ever seen. = the funniest | the funnyest | funniest | the most funny
Your bag is as ____ as mine. = big | bigger | biggest | more big
A car is ____ expensive than a bicycle. = more | most | much | the most
She is ____ girl in the family. = the youngest | the more young | youngest | the most young
My new job is ____ than my old one. = better | gooder | best | more good
This road is ____ than that one. = narrower | more narrow | narrowest | narrowerer
He is ____ person I know. = the most generous | the generousest | most generous | the more generous
My sister is two years ____ than me. = older | elder than | more old | oldest
This is ____ day of my life! = the happiest | the happyest | happiest | the more happy
Which is ____, the sun or the moon? = bigger | biggest | the biggest | more big
He speaks English ____ than I do. = better | gooder | more good | best
